items.title: Butch Miles interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Jerry Bergonzi was on tenor sax at the time... I had no problem with the odd time signatures because that was something else that I used to practice... I must be a big band drummer

ctx.x: I wonder, I always wondered how Brubeck felt about that, that he was such a writer but the band’s biggest hit, you know, he didn’t write.

Yeah, I know, Paul Desmond. There’s two stories about that, one that I heard and I’ve never even actually asked Dave this, although Dave I think told somebody that Desmond had written that. But somebody else, and this hearsay, absolute hearsay, but somebody else said that Dave had actually written “Take Five” but he put Paul’s name on it. Now I don’t know. But knowing probably, well knowing how Dave is, the version that he tells is the correct one, so I’m sure that Desmond wrote it. But he was a great guy. I had…
